title: AI art
description: Some of my AI art, mostly generated on my iPad.

ai_castle.jpeg.alt: A castle lit up on a misty clifftop under a full moon, with riders on horseback on the path below and ravens circling

andromeda_astronaut.jpeg.alt: A cartoon astronaut with purple hair and big blue eyes, with planets and a spiral galaxy behind her

cat_and_fox_supporting.jpeg.alt: A cartoon grey kitten and an orange fox smiling and nuzzling each other

developers.jpeg.alt: Four developers chatting around a table with laptops, in an office full of screens and plants

dragon.jpeg.alt: A black and orange dragon with glowing eyes and spread wings, surrounded by fire

dragon_2.jpeg.alt: A roaring dark blue dragon with red spines and fire around it, in front of smoking mountains

dragon_blessing.jpeg.alt: A huge serpent-like dragon coiled in a ring above a small figure standing on a rock

dragon_mecha.jpeg.alt: A white and blue armoured mecha holding a large rifle and a shield with a dragon emblem

fairy_reading.jpeg.alt: A fairy with butterfly wings in a night-time garden, holding a glowing butterfly as others fly around her

fluffy_fox.jpeg.alt: A fluffy cream-coloured fox with blue eyes and several tails, sitting in a forest

glass_nebula_fox.jpeg.alt: A sitting fox made of glass, filled with stars and nebula colours, on a windowsill

sith_cat.jpeg.alt: A black cat with yellow eyes in a dark hooded robe, holding a red lightsaber
